description: This file defines an Error Boundary React component for error handling in a React application. It captures errors in child components, displays an error message, and provides options to report the error or clear application data.

classes.name: ErrorBoundary
classes.description: React component that intercepts rendering errors in child components, updates its state accordingly, and renders an error UI with options to report the error or reset data.

methods.name: componentDidCatch
methods.description: React lifecycle method that catches errors in child components and updates the component state to reflect the error.

methods.name: clearAndSaveData
methods.description: Exports data via useSyncStore, clears local storage, and reloads the page to reset application state.

methods.name: render
methods.description: Renders either the error message UI when an error has occurred or the child components if no error.
